explication: JustDelete.me is a multilingual directory that helps visitors find direct account-deletion instructions for web services. Its central workflow is browsing or searching the directory, comparing deletion difficulty and notes, then following a service’s deletion or help link. The repository also includes translated UI content and optional service email/domain metadata. The README documents these capabilities; the sampled source is limited to build tooling, so client-side wiring is not asserted.
